name: 엔트로피 분포
useCase: Detecting AI text through entropy uniformity analysis
mechanism: Calculates sliding-window entropy across the content and analyzes the distribution variance. AI text typically shows more uniform entropy distribution compared to human writing.
source: Gehrmann et al. (2019) - GLTR: Statistical Detection of Generated Text
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Gehrmann et al. (2019) - GLTR: Statistical Detection of Generated Text
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
